top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 71 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: The Deadline Watch check found one sitting member with no CY2025 annual report on file after every extension has run out.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed for an extension on June 4, 2026. The final extension date was August 13, 2026, and the check found no CY2025 annual financial disclosure from him on file 71 days after that date. He is the only sitting member flagged. The check compares each member against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD, and a filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can read as missing.
The Senate half of the check failed today (Senate eFD returned an unreadable response), so the result covers House members reliably but the Senate only partly.

Separately, the Ethics Agreement Tracker lists seven confirmed officials with no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance more than 30 days past deadline. The longest is Michelle White Bowman, Governor and Vice Chairman for Supervision of the Federal Reserve System Board of Governors, confirmed June 4, 2025, whose certification was due September 2, 2025, 416 days ago.

sections.headline: Five ethics agreements and compliance certifications from State Department and Office of Special Counsel officials
paragraphs: The U.S. Office of Government Ethics released five ethics agreement filings from senior officials confirmed in August 2026. Assistant Secretary Anny Vu's ethics agreement details significant asset divestitures required by her position; four additional officials filed compliance certifications. Routine transaction and annual disclosure filings from 16 officials across ten agencies were also released this week.

items: Michael E. Graham, Member 2, National Transportation Safety Board — Termination (only the fact of the termination is confirmed, not the asset). Request this Document.
Laurence Socha, Ambassador to Gambia (Republic of), Department of State — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. Ethics agreement signed 6/10/2026; confirmed 8/7/2026. Certification (PDF).

Anny Vu, Assistant Secretary for Emerging Threats, Department of State — Ethics Agreement. Vu must divest interests in Meta Platforms, JPMorgan Chase, Apple, Amazon, and MicroStrategy; additionally, she must divest the iShares Semiconductor Fund and Rex AI Equity Premium Income Fund within 90 days of confirmation. Ethics Agreement (PDF).

Charles Baldis, Special Counsel, Office of Special Counsel — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. Ethics agreement signed June 17, 2026; confirmed August 7, 2026. Certification (PDF).

sections.headline: Two registrants add foreign principals: Montenegro's tourism board and Okinawa Prefecture
paragraphs: No new registrants and no terminated registrants appear in this window. Two existing registrants took on new foreign principals, and two registrants reported agents ending their work for foreign principals. Five informational-materials filings, five short-form filings and three supplemental statements also came in.

items: Miles Partnership, LLLP (#7382) now represents the National Tourism Organisation of Montenegro (Montenegro) from Oct. 21, 2026. Its amendment and Exhibit AB say the firm has a procurement agreement to provide public relations services in the United States market, with a 12-month term and a total contract value of EUR 24,990. Filings: new principal, amendment, Exhibit AB.

Mercury Public Affairs, LLC (#6170) now represents Okinawa Prefecture (Japan) from Oct. 20, 2026. The filing describes the principal as a local government, names Kazuhiro Miyagi, Director of the Military Base Affairs Division, and gives a contract date of Sept. 1, 2026. It says services are anticipated to include government relations advice and services, including possible outreach to U.S. governmental officials. The amendment is signed David Vitter. Filings: new principal, amendment, Exhibit AB.

Washington Media Group (#7407) reported that Meghan Hays terminated her relationship with foreign principal the Qatar Foundation for Education, Science and Community Development (Qatar) and her connection with the registrant on Oct. 1, 2026. The filing says she is no longer working with Washington Media Group or the Qatar Foundation. Amendment.

Clock Tower X LLC (#7649) reported that Aaron Milhoan terminated his relationship with foreign principal Havas Media Network (Germany) and with the registrant on Oct. 16, 2026, noting he is no longer employed by the registrant. The amendment is signed Brad Parscale. Amendment.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

sections.headline: Rep. Robert E. Latta filed 6 trade reports last year, none in 91 days
paragraphs: 1 House member(s) with a history of frequent stock trading have stopped filing trade reports.

items: Rep. Robert E. Latta (R-OH-5) filed 6 periodic transaction reports in the 12 months from 7/25/2025 to 7/25/2026, and none in the 91 days since the last, on 7/24/2026

blocks.text: House members who filed 6 or more periodic transaction reports (STOCK Act trade disclosures) in the year before the last 90 days and none since, per the House Clerk's disclosure index. Silence doesn't say why: the member may have sold off holdings, moved assets into a blind trust or index fund, been covered by a new law, or just not traded -- and trades are reportable up to 45 days late, so the latest ones may not be filed yet. House members only; the Senate's e-filing search isn't covered.
